kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أتكأكأ (form IIq)
# أَتَكَأْكَأُ (ʔatakaʔkaʔu) /ʔa.ta.kaʔ.ka.ʔu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَكَأْكَأَ (takaʔkaʔa)
# أَتَكَأْكَأَ (ʔatakaʔkaʔa) /ʔa.ta.kaʔ.ka.ʔa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَكَأْكَأَ (takaʔkaʔa)
# أَتَكَأْكَأْ (ʔatakaʔkaʔ) /ʔa.ta.kaʔ.kaʔ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَكَأْكَأَ (takaʔkaʔa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
